name: EPIC 205931354
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 10.0 solar radii and 0.86 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 205931354 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.042788 (16th-84th percentiles 9.791038-10.434396), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,084 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.86 solar masses and 10.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,857 K at its surface.
